description: Renames a site's link to name.dropthehassle.app. The previous link redirects to the new one. Without an account, claim_url or site_token identifies the unclaimed site. With an account, site identifies it. confirm=true applies the new name. Does not charge.

claim_url.description: The claim link from an unclaimed deploy. The part after # is the secret.

confirm.description: True applies the change. False leaves it unchanged and the reply describes what would change.

name.description: The label only, e.g. "myproject" for myproject.dropthehassle.app.

site.description: With an account: the address of the site to rename, for example myproject.dropthehassle.app.

site_token.description: Without an account: that site's token, from the deploy reply. A site token sent as Bearer works too.

name: choose_link
title: Choose link
